page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, right of centre; a running head with page number at the top; faint text of the neighbouring page at the far left edge (not transcribed). No notes in the margins of this page; the digitiser's banner at the bottom is left out.

main_text.p: ei & fuco infecta facies: in graciles arcus accuratissimè detonsa supercilia: in pariles utrimque cincinnos, cunctante calamistro, divisa caesaries: Collum & brachia inter byssum & vittas circumludunt monilia: Ex utroque humero, in alterna femora pertinentes, pectus & tergum decussant bullatę torques: Acu-picta vestis, mille meandris in se revoluta, mille fimbriis praetexta, mille striis intorta, centum-coloribus laciniis, digitos pedum lambit, & longo secundum calcem exundat in terram syrmate: Gestus ei, nutus, incessus, elocutionis accentus, tussis,

page.notes: The running head has the page number 113 at the right. The first line of the page is a continuation of a sentence from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "bullatę" (the final letter may be a ligature for -que); "tussis," is set flush right on the last line. Left edge shows show-through and fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.
